title: Source who has been inside S4
summary: UAPGerb tells of Source who has been inside S4, about unspecified at S4, near Papoose Lake, Nevada, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I've actually I've I've talked to one person who has been to S4

plain: An online UFO researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb says he has spoken with one person who has been to S4, a secret site said to lie near Papoose Lake in Nevada, close to the military base known as Area 51. He does not name the source. The claim matters because S4 is said to be where the government keeps and studies craft that are not of human origin.
